description:
Configure system lookup lists in HospitalRun Administration. You need to add new options to three dropdown lists used in clinical forms.

1. Navigate to Administration > Lookup Lists.
2. Add 'Orthopedic Consultation' to the 'Visit Types' list.
3. Add 'Orthopedics Wing B' to the 'Visit Location List'.
4. Add 'Dr. Sarah Mitchell' to the 'Physician List'.

Ensure all values are saved.
